meta.view: side profile view, full body, character facing RIGHT, feet on ground or hover shadow
meta.canvas_hint: 512x512 or 768x768 PNG, solid dark purple #2a2438 or transparent background
meta.negative: top-down view, bird eye view, overhead, isometric, front view, back view, blurry, smooth, realistic photo, 3d render, multiple characters, watermark, text, logo, UI frame, extra limbs, deformed hands, cropped, chibi bobblehead, same design repeated, high resolution, detailed painting, gradient shading, anti-aliasing, soft edges, illustration, concept art, 4k, hd pixel art, painterly, airbrush
meta.style_base: TRUE low-res pixel art, 64x64 sprite, maximum 16 colors, visible square pixels, NO smooth gradients, NO soft shading, SNES era RPG sprite, hard edges, 1px black outline, indexed color look

units.name: 步兵 Infantry
units.style_note: 矮壮重装、剑盾、最「标准士兵」
units.prompt: A pixel art game sprite of a STOUT medieval foot knight infantry. Side profile facing right. Short wide silhouette, blue steel plate armor #6B82B8, large round shield on left arm, long sword on right hand, closed helmet with visor slit, yellow star badge on chest plate, thick armored boots planted on ground. Heavy grounded warrior, not tall. Dark muted purple background.

units.name: 火枪手 Musketeer
units.style_note: 高瘦、羽帽、长火枪，和步兵完全不同
units.prompt: A pixel art game sprite of a TALL SLIM renaissance musketeer. Side profile facing right. Narrow silhouette, dark navy coat #4D6AA8, wide feathered musketeer hat, long matchlock musket held horizontally pointing right, leather bandolier, TWO yellow stars on collar (veteran rank). Elegant agile soldier, much taller and thinner than a knight. Dark muted purple background.
